scope: Isolated meal facts parser and deterministic Markdown renderer; no database or provider calls

results.name: Visible foods and cautious advice are parsed without adding personal facts
Malformed JSON, prose, code fences and non-object roots are rejected without echoing the payload
Only the three required arrays are accepted; extra diary/time/feeling fields cannot enter the template
Array counts and item length limits accept the boundary and reject the next value
Nested values and multiline or control-character strings cannot inject additional record fields
Food names cannot carry obvious first-person, meal-time or feeling narratives in Chinese or English
Uncertainty and suggestion fields reject personal-experience claims but accept general advice
Renderer creates deterministic Markdown with fixed unknown personal fields and no raw model JSON
Renderer keeps advice separate from facts and escapes Markdown supplied in every model field
Renderer validates again instead of trusting caller-created facts objects
The isolated contract run makes no network requests

renderedExample:
## 可见食物

- 米饭
- 西兰花
- 番茄

## 饮食记录草稿

- 食物：米饭、西兰花、番茄
- 用餐日期与时间：待补充
- 实际食用量：待补充
- 个人感受：待补充

请确认食物名称，并按实际情况补充记录。照片不能确认实际食用量或个人感受。

## 需要确认

- 无法仅凭图片确定实际食用量。

## 一般搭配建议

- 可以搭配适量蛋白质来源。
